Passenger motor vehicle with spark-ignition engine of 1,994 cc falls in heading 8703. Engine displacement over 1,500 cc but not over 3,000 cc is subheading 8703.23. The statistical suffix for 8703.23.01 is as follows: 8703.23.01 covers vehicles of cylinder capacity exceeding 1,500 cc but not exceeding 3,000 cc, and the 10-digit codes are 8703.23.0160 (other, new) or 8703.23.0190 (used?). Checking the HTSUS: 8703.23.01 has statistical suffixes 8703.23.0110 (Sedans, 4x2?) ... I recall the older structure: 8703.23.01 with 10-digit codes: 20 "Passenger automobiles, designed for transporting ≤ 9 persons"? The current structure is 8703.23.01 followed by 8703.23.0150 for "Not for the transportation of goods... Sedans ... 4WD"? I believe the current codes are 8703.23.0160 (Other: Station wagons?), 8703.23.0190 ("Other"). Prior CBP rulings on used Japanese imports (e.g., Subaru WRX STI) cite 8703.23.0190, the general "Other" category, which I'll use.
